title: Akiyama Mizuki — Card Story

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Sigh...
I'm getting hungry.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<You want to eat at this hour?
It's going to be super bad for your skin and make you put on weight.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Depends on what I eat, right?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Yes, it's easy to get hungry while you're working. Oh, K, can you take a look at the lyrics here?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Okay.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Speaking of food, K, you're always eating instant noodles, right? What brand and what flavor?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <This one...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Oh! This photo was taken in your room, K?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <So that's what your room looks like...>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Excuse me, we're talking about instant noodles here.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <K eats instant noodles every day.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <What? Every single day?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Yes. Because you can eat them as long as there's hot water. Yuki, thanks for the lyrics. I think they're good.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Great. I'll keep going in this direction, then.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Hey, back to the noodles.
I agree they're convenient, but they're also not too healthy for the body, right?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I also eat nutrition bars.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Oh. Well at least you're taking care of yourself.
Aren't you tired of always having the same thing every day, though?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Not really.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: (Which means what she eats is so delicious that she doesn't mind having it every day?)
The next day

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Sigh... I'm so hungry...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Again? You said the same thing yesterday.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I'm a growing child!>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Hehe. So what are you going to eat today?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Instant noodles!
I bought the exact same one K was telling us about.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<What, you too?
I went out to buy that particular brand out of curiosity, too...>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <You mean you sent your li'l bro to buy it for you?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I bought it myself today.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Today, huh. Poor li'l bro.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'll go boil some water now.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Me too.
K, let's take a little break.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Okay.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Has it been three minutes already?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Probably?
Mine is already three minutes in.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Time to dig in!
Fwoo, fwoo... Wow, it's good.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<I'm digging in, too!
Get in there!>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Huh? Did I just hear a plopping sound?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<What was that?
You forgot to add the condiments?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Nah, I was dropping in some ice cubes.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Ice cubes?
Into your instant noodles?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Yeah, I have a sensitive tongue, you see.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Now, stir well until the ice melts and...done.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Wouldn't that weaken the flavor?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I put in less hot water to make room for the ice, so it'll be fine!>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <You have this all thought out.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Okay, that should do.
Yes, the temperature's perfect♪>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Hey, this is pretty good for an occasional meal! Yummy♪>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: (What a strange way to eat instant noodles...)
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I attended school, and today's classes were so boring.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe I should just go home... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
If I put this here...like this.
And then this part here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, it's working well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All by yourself in a lonely place as usual, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh my. Is that you, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's me. What're you up to, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You mean this robot? As you can see, I'm outfitting it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow, this stumpy little thing's a robot too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're using it for one of your shows?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I made it a long time ago, but with some modifications, it can be controlled remotely.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's not very cute for something to be used in a show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was going to work on its appearance after I finished outfitting it. I haven't reached that part, yet.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see. Which means you haven't made any costumes for it either, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Costumes? Yes, I may need to give it something to wear.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right? If you don't mind, I can make something for it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I'll make it super cute too♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Cute, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You haven't changed at all.
Still the same old Mizuki with a weakness for anything cute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ah, you finally turned around.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You haven't changed either, always so focused on your tinkering even when you're talking to someone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, it's a habit already.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
And as for the costume...
I'm going to give this robot to a friend of mine to use.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll be making it look like that friend as well, so would you be able to make something to go along with that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can! It sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now how should I go about doing this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe I should just leave school and start making it now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, Mizuki, what inspired you to come to school today for a change, anyway? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um, nothing? Everything's fine.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you say so.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I did get to talk to the legendary school weirdo, so coming to school today on a whim was well worth it♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, that's a great honor indeed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Encountering a rarely seen student in the wild has put me in quite a good mood as well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aha, so that makes two of us, eh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, once you're done fixing up the robot, let me know. I'll make it the cutest outfit anyone has ever seen!
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Look at that, Ena uploaded another selfie.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Look at this cute blouse and hat I found!
Hmm, they do look nice on her...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The sleeves are bothering me, though.
And the hat could use some embellishments too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The sleeves should be narrower... And the hat decorated with lace and some pearls...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, this would look much better!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I can cute up that outfit you just posted about!>
There, message sent.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see what she says.
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey there, Ena!
Did you bring the outfit?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Here it is.
Are you sure this is going to work?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The edited photo you sent me looked cute, but can you actually do those modifications in real life?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You don't trust my sewing skills?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Why should I?
Having good taste in fashion doesn't make you a tailor.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Well, I'll show you what I can do!
Come on♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? Where are we going?
I thought you just wanted me to bring you the clothes?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I wouldn't have called you out all the way here if it was only for that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Come on, it'll be fun. I promise♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here we are!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You brought us to a diner?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's not a diner anymore!
It's been repurposed as a sewing lounge.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A...sewing lounge?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Take a look at the tables!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, they have lots of sewing machines here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. Anyone can use them for free, but you pay for coffee and food.

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Hello, Mizuki.
You brought a friend today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! Is the machine I normally use free?

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Yes. That'll be table number two.
Let me know if you need anything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks♪
It's this way, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay.
So you have a specific sewing machine you use?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, because there are all sorts and they're good for different things. The one I like has embroidery settings, like for overlock stitching.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see now that they do in fact look different. Aw, this one looks adorable. It looks like an antique!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Go ahead and order some nibbles. And cola for me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, let's get everything set up...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, this lace is lovely!
Is this what you drew in that picture?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, and here are the pearls.
Wait a bit and I'll get them sewn on.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What are these? Color pencils?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
They're chalk pens for marking fabric.
Didn't you use those in your home economics class?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm, maybe?
I don't remember much from it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: At my current school, home ec is mostly about cooking.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh, so you cook at night?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you're always pushing chores onto your brother. Do you have him do the cooking assignments for you too?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can do that much myself!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, that's enough teasing you for now. I've got to focus on narrowing the sleeves. I'll put a string through here and tie it like a ribbon...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'll add some lace to the blouse, too... Oh, I have some left over. Could use this to make flower decorations for the hat...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, I'm finished!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, that was quick!
I'm still eating my sandwich.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm an expert at this sort of thing♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, take a look! Isn't it nice?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow! It's adorable!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Told you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're so talented at modding clothes!
It wouldn't look out of place on the shelves of a fancy store!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thank you, thank you!
I soak up praise like a sponge!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, and when you post a new photo of this outfit on your social media account...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Make sure to mention you got it modified for you by your super cute, super helpful, super nice friend♪
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Morning, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Female Student
rows.Line: Mizuki! I haven't seen you in forever!

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line:
You actually came to school.
Is it because the exams are soon?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's kinda it.

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heya.
You look like you could go for a nap.

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: Huh?! Uh, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Did he just give me the stink eye?

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Don't mind him.

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Unlike most of us, he's not used to you, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess so.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't want people to just get used to me, but to try to understand me. Is that too much to ask?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Why can't they just accept me for who I am?)
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oof, I'm finally back.
Now, let's log in to Nightcord!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Enanan, you're here!
Hey there!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What's up, Amia? You sound tired.
Is it because of school?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, it was exhausting! I had P.E. in the afternoon, and that was a real killer.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Say, did something happen while you were at school?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What? Why do you ask?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You sound different today.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Really? Maybe you're imagining it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I kind of think so, too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, I didn't notice you were online, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I just set my status to offline.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Are you guys talking about a new song?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, Yuki. We've got the full squad now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We were just asking Amia if something's wrong.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's not a big deal, honestly...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But since it's come up, let me first ask you guys, what do you think about me?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <How do you mean?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Like my appearance.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think...that you're cute, I guess.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You're really hesitating there!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I think you're more stylish rather than cute, even though our taste in fashion's different.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Is it, really? Didn't you absolutely love the outfit I modded for you the other day?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But that's not what we're talking about now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think you're simply yourself, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hmm?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You follow your own sense of what's right for you, and that makes you look cool and confident.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think it's this feistiness that's the most distinctive about you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Feistiness, huh...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You said something similar to me when you were inviting me to the group.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (How could I forget that there actually are people who naturally accept me without me having to fight for it?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe. So we all agree that I'm cute and stylish♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You sound like yourself again, annoying as usual.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Hehe.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, since everyone's here...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Let's work on something we can only do when we're all together! We have until Enanan's got to go to her night classes♪>
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Humhumhuuum♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm so cute today too♪
This ribbon is especially cute. It doesn't feel out of place on my school uniform!
Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Morning, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki!
Decided to come to school today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. Just felt like it.

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line:
You're so random, Mizuki.
We're already having our lunch break right now, you know.

rows.Speaker: Female Student B
rows.Line: Just your luck that we're having a mini-test in math class on the day you decide to drop by, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Mini-test?
Which period is math again?

rows.Speaker: Female Student B
rows.Line:
The fifth period.
Which means right after lunch.

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line: Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ugh! That just put a damper on my mood all of a sudden! I need to get some fresh air for a change of pace♪

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line:
Fresh air? But you just came...
Ah. Gone with the wind.
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Urgh... I don't feel like doing a mini-test today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's such a pain. Guess I could always just go home... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Someone's singing over there...
Isn't that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Mizuki? Decided to come to school today, huh?
It's already afternoon, though.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, just felt like it today.
Never mind that. I didn't know you could sing so well, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I learned by listening to my dad.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh...
So your father really likes music, then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup, he used to be a musician, and before I realized it, I started to be able to sing as well just by trying to imitate him.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Eventually, I developed my own dream and now I'm singing in live shows and doing street performances too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No wonder...
Do you happen to have any tips for singing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? I guess I may know of a few...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Can you teach me then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You like singing too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe, kinda? I'm in this song-making group and we upload the songs we compose online, see?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wow, I had no idea!
That sounds pretty fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But that's also why I hope to become better at singing. So, can you share some tips with me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Some tips, huh... I can give you some pointers, but I guess most important thing is to always do your vocal warm-ups.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: For example, like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Amazing... This isn't an ordinary vocal warm-up!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can really tell how serious An is about her music!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Phew! Something like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That was awesome!
I was totally blown away!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha.
Aww, you're making me blush.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How do I do what you just did? Teach me, please!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank you, An. I'm going to try it out right away!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I didn't know you liked music so much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You were listening so seriously to my advice.
You must really love to sing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, sing for me next time, okay?
I'm really curious about what you sound like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe, sure thing!
I'll pick the song I'm best at and sing it just for you♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great, I'll be waiting!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Ah, the bell just went off.
Mizuki, let's go back to class.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah, I'm going to practice here for a bit longer. You can go on ahead.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mizuki... You're not thinking of skipping, are you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha... I really want to apply what I just learned while it's still fresh in my mind. Can I please?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm afraid not! You can't expect me to just smile and nod at someone about to skip class right in front of me now, can you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, stop pulling my uniform!
Come on, An!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, everyone, thanks for waiting♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're late, Mizuki!
We were just about to start watching without you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, don't be so impatient, Ena.
I'm only late by about five minutes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Since we're all here now, shall we begin?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll start the video now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We received so many comments this time too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The chorus seems to be the most popular part.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's the part Mizuki sang.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmph! I asked this friend of mine who's a great singer to share some tips with me♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, the lyrics here were fantastic, so I had a lot of fun singing them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I agree that the lyrics for that part were very good.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You do?
I'm glad you liked them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you have to give me some credit for expressing Mafuyu's lyrics so well too♪ Right, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Ena?
Is she still watching the video?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
She looks so serious.
We had better not talk to her now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Is Ena looking for comments about the illustrations?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Many people commented about the lyrics and melody for this song, but not about the illustrations...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think Ena's illustrations for this song were really good.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The thumbnail captures the mood of the song perfectly and makes it obvious this is a song by us!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is that some sort of misguided attempt to cheer me up? I don't need any of that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No! I meant it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really... Okay, fine.
Anyway, I'm starting to get hungry.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How about fries? Let's order some fries!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Again?! You eat that every time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because I like them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't complain if you start getting acne everywhere!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't worry!
Acne can't help but stay away from someone as cute as I am♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, fine. Good for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Though we're chatting together happily like this now, we're all still weighed down by our own burdens.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I would like to have some fries too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (For Kanade, it's her father.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then let's order that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Mafuyu can't find her true self.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, I'll get a drink too since they offer free refills.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Ena's always struggling with her drawings too.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And then there's myself...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But it's tough to always be in agony, so...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Excuse me, waiter!
Three large portions of fries for this table, please♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How much are you intending to eat?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As much as I can because it's my favorite food♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm allowed to enjoy my life at least for now, right?)
Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Great job, everyone♪
I think we really outdid ourselves this time too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks, Kanade, for uploading the song this morning.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, Kanade, you're staring a hole into that menu there. Did you skip meals again?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I haven't eaten anything since yesterday, because I wanted to upload the song as soon as I could.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then we should order quickly so that Kanade can get some food into her system soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ah, I'll get some fries then.
It shouldn't take long for them to be served♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What would you like, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anything...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Again? If anything's fine then just pick something.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In that case... I'll get some fries too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, let's get a large serving and eat together!
Excuse me, waiter! We'd like to order!

rows.Speaker: Diner Staff
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting. Here's your extra large fries.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Food's here! Oh, but the fries are still piping hot.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Life's tough when you have a sensitive tongue...
Oh, Kanade and Ena, feel free to help yourself♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sure. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't mind if I do!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's wrong, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I taste nothing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh... I know!
Why don't we drizzle some soy sauce on them?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
If you do that, only Mafuyu will be able to eat the fries.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, the fries are already salted, so why are you trying to make them even saltier?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There are so many better seasonings we could eat the fries with, like avocado dips and cheese dips, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unfortunately, they don't provide that here. For condiments, there are only soy sauce and ketchup. Hey, how about we put even more salt on the fries, then?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm fine with anything.
It'll just taste the same to me, anyway.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You may be fine, but I'm not!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I saw a few dipping sauces on the menu just now. Should we order some?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So they do have dipping sauces here!
Why were you trying to put us through that risky taste experiment, then?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not at all! We should absolutely try figuring something out with just the condiments available on the table!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's the point?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Well, I guess the mood's definitely better than before.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We've all got stuff going on in our lives, so it's not like we can be normal friends, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Getting to know Mafuyu better through the doll exhibition was a major milestone.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm glad I got everyone to go, even if I had to be a little forceful about it. We're not so awkward around each other anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm such a thoughtful and considerate person!
Whoa, hang on!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey! Why're the fries already almost gone?
I was just waiting for them to cool down a little!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You told us to help ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yes, but you'd usually hold back a little, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's hard to stop once you start, especially for fries.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I find it intriguing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Not you too, Kanade... Wait!
Of course. Kanade's stomach was completely empty just now!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. But I'm full now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ah... There goes most of my fries...
Mafuyu, you should really stop eating with such a businesslike face.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do you want this instead?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Ena, you're so nice! But that's lasagna, right? You know I can't eat food that's too hot!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hot food tears the skin in my mouth to shreds!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't make it sound so gross.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade, your order is here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The plate of fries is kind of blocking the table. Let's get the waiter to clear it for us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? Ah! My fries! They're all gone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Waiter! Another large portion of fries please!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, and when it's ready, could you please let it cool down a little before bringing it out? Thanks...
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Good not-so-morning♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Just kidding. No one's gonna around in the day—>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Good morning.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh? Yuki?! Wait...why?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What do you mean? Today is Sunday.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Right... I haven't been going to school much lately, so I honestly had no idea.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's still unusual to see you on Nightcord at this hour on a Sunday, though. Don't you have club activities?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <No club activities today. That's why I'm studying at home.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm almost done, though, so I was thinking of doing some work.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, okay. Um, is it urgent work, by any chance?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <No.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Great! I've been doing some research on my own after the doll exhibition the other day, so let me tell what I found♪>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What were you researching?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Exhibitions! It occurred to me that looking at works and stuff may be a good stimulus.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The doll exhibition helped me to see that looking at things like that can be quite good for inspiration.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Trick art, fashion design...oh! And a personal exhibition being held in a small gallery too! Everything seems pretty interesting!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I think it's something about abstract art?
It's really cool, in any case!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I glanced at the art and it was...how do I say this. It's not something you can easily describe in words. Seriously, you have to see it with your own eyes to—>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oops, sorry! That was too much info at once, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That's not it...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Why do you care so much about me?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K promised to compose a song that will save me.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But neither you nor Enanan have any reason to care about me that much. So...why?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Why, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Don't be such a stranger. We're friends, aren't we?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Friends?
I thought we were only members of the same songmaking group?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Well, it's definitely hard to define our relationship with any of the usual youthful friendship tropes.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But both of us are quite alike.
In the sense that people around us refuse to recognize our true selves.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The way we're forced to act out a twisted version of ourselves, and how we struggle with that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What she's dealing with just feels so personal to me.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Don't worry about it. I'm doing this because I want to.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So you don't have to think too deeply into it.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I see. I'll take your word for it, then.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm going back to work now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I got it! Oh, and make sure you also think about which exhibition we'll be going to next together, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And nowhere is not an acceptable answer!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'll think about it...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sounds like she doesn't mind going to another exhibition together, then. Excellent.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really hope Mafuyu finds what she's looking for soon.
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Morning♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Morning, Mizuki...
Wait, it's past noon already!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, me turning up for classes is a special event in and of itself, no matter how late I am.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Speaking of events...
Thanks for giving me that call earlier!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm? What call?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: About the school festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh that!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have to thank you for getting me out of the house and to the festival.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But hang on. Why did you invite me to come when I didn't do anything to help with it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's a special event, so I thought it'd be a shame if you missed it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But hey, maybe you'll get to take part in the first years' festival next year if they hold you back for being absent so much!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Urgh, I'd rather not be a repeater...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (An didn't want me to miss out...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At first I thought she gave me that call because it was her duty as the hall monitor or something, but she did it just out of friendship.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And she was so mindful of my situation...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Oh, and lots of students are wearing funky outfits today. A lot of the second years are in costume for their class shows too. It's really cool!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Unless you wear something really crazy, it's gonna be hard to stand out in this crowd.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We've been friends since I started high school, but I haven't really been telling her much about myself...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Still, I feel comfortable around her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, guess what!
I met my friend's brother at the festival!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You mean Akito? Yeah, he told me.
I was surprised that he has an older sister.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's a second year, but only attends the night classes. I met her online and we've been making music together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wow, that's cool!
Was she at the festival too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nah. Her brother said she was probably sleeping.
Ena's sleeping pattern is totally backwards.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's kind of like you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What? Hey! No, it's not!
I was awake when you called me, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess so!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, it was also news to me that you knew Rui.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
He's an old friend from middle school.
You're friends with him too?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, but I have run-ins with him while on duty...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ah... I had a feeling it was something like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it was good to see him enjoying the festival.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When we were in middle school, we never participated in anything like that. We mostly just wasted time hanging out on the rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Back then, we didn't have any other friends to talk to, so we talked with each other a lot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, that's just how it was back then!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now, Rui has his own circle of friends and seems happy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, he was hanging out with Tenma, wasn't he?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I really wish he'd stopped bringing weird stuff to school.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So how have you been doing, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me? Um...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm having more fun these days, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've got some friends I can talk to comfortably, like you. I made some new friends too, and I've been creating music videos.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: These new friends, are they from the same group as Akito's sister?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Bingo!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're all smiles today.
Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, you're telling me about yourself!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Usually we just talk about fashion or some random stuff, but you almost never tell me about yourself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh. It's only with you that I feel like I can be this open.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You might've developed a knack for making people comfortable talking to you after working at your dad's cafe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You think so? Oh, but you're not getting any freebies from this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Not even one cup of coffee on the house for your dear friend?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & An
rows.Line: Hahaha!
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hmhmhmmmm〜♪
This goes here and... Perfect.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K, I added an effect to the chorus in the vid for some added cuteness. You check it out too, Yuki! There, sent♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Got it. Playing it now...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah, it's nice.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think so too. Kind of flashy, but not in a bad way.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <See? I'll keep going with this then!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Sure. Hey, Amia.
You seem cheerful.
Things going well for you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. I guess they have been since the School Festival♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh, you're all here already?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hi, Enanan! Did you just get back from school?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, I didn't have school today. I was eating dinner.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I see. Anyway, great timing!
I was just telling everyone about the School Festival.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh yeah, that was at our school.
I'm guessing you went to it then?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I did! A classmate called me that morning and asked me to come. The plan was for us to stick together...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But stuff happened, and then I met your brother!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What? You met Akito?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, he told me that he met a friend of mine or something... It was you all along.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Sigh... I should've gone too.
I could've snapped some good school life pics.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I just totally forgot about it and slept until evening.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Doesn't every class have to prepare a show or some other display for the festival? Was your night class exempt?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Um... No, but I didn't help with anything...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Neither did I.
But...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Poor Enanan... I had a friend who invited me along anyway, and she didn't... Boohoo...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Excuse me? What are you trying to start?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hahaha. Sorry.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Next time we should all go.
Together as N25.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Us too? Why?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Because it's fun to walk around and look at all the stuff everyone put together. You would've all had a good time. Even you, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <When I was there, I was trying to imagine how it would've been if you guys came with.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <There were so many different shows and stalls, like a theater performance, a haunted house, yakisoba, cotton candy...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<The second years' show was so crazy too.
Well, you know, in a good way!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<It was dramatic, but the plot was nuts!
Impossible to follow, but really funny.
I was wondering how Yuki would've reacted.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And how K might've reacted to the haunted house. I mean, it was seriously spooky!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Enanan would've been taking selfies against the cotton candy stall with all their cute animal designs!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I kept thinking how much more fun it would've been if we'd all gone together.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And you know what! There was is night festival after that for Kamiyama students only too...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia, I don't know if I've ever seen you this excited.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I was just thinking that too. The School Festival must've been really fun.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<If it really was all that,
maybe I'll show up next year.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah. I'm interested too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Seriously?! What about you, Yuki?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I could go if I have the time to...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That's a promise, right♪
Next time, we're all going!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, it just dawned on me that we could go to Yuki's School Festival! When's your school doing theirs?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'll tell you next year.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Okay, don't forget!
Haha. I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You just went to a School Festival, and you still want more?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Why not? Also, waiting for something exciting is part of the fun too!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Next year, I'll make sure to help with my class' prep.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(So when the N25 crew shows up,
I'll present it to them with pride♪)
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, time to kick it into overdrive!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia, you seem awfully excited...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <At least for me, Marionette showed me that we'll get a good response if we actually work hard.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, we put so much time and effort into these songs, so you'd sort of want people to recognize that, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I agree.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Speaking of which... Enanan, I'm looking forward to see some good stuff from you♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hm? Heey! Enanaaan, you still there?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, sorry. I spaced out a little...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Aww, come on! We agreed to really get cracking yesterday, didn't we?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We did...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hang on. You're not falling asleep now, are you?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No. But I need to get back to work so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay, fine.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I need to get back to work too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. If something comes up, I'll post it in the chat.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay♪ See ya later!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hmm... There's something off about, Enanan. She wasn't sleep or anything, but didn't seem to have much energy.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Moving on, let's finish up our new song. We only have a little bit to go before it's ready to upload.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Ena
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, something's definitely up.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's not like there's much I can do...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Made it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena, there you are! You seem down, and you don't look so good. Are you feeling okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I didn't get enough sleep, so my make-up might be off a little.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? I'm glad that you invited me and all, but are you sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm fine. Honestly, I wouldn't come out all this way to get food with you if I weren't.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, here come the thorns...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But she actually came so...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, before we eat, you wanna look around and do some shopping?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sure, why not?
Oh, the light's green.
Let's go!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, this one-piece with the ribbons is super cute! The pattern on the fabric looks nice and probably looks gorgeous in a silhouette.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, and it's a really good fabric for the price. That dress might go well with... Oh, how about this underneath?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Good eye! But... No, there are too many choices...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We have time. Let's keep looking.
Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's dig in♪
Mmm! Curry really is too delicious!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You just had that kebab too. How do you still have room for more?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, think of curry as a liquid. You know, like a drink?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Uh, sure.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She still seems a little down compared to usual, but I think she's starting to feel better...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Maybe she really just didn't get enough sleep. At least, I hope that's the case...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you staring at me? Wait, you're not gonna steal my parfait, are you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? Oh, hahaha. No no no.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's just that you didn't seem to have much energy yesterday, so I was just wondering if you forgot to do your homework and got into trouble...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*... We're not in elementary school anymore, so stuff like that won't bother me like it used to.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh? But you're not denying that you forgot to do your homework?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I realized that I didn't and got it all done just before class, so I'm fine now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! How's that fine?! You were pretty much busted!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But if there is something going on, you can tell me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? What's this all the sudden?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, I really haven't been going to school lately, so I've sort of been yearning to talk to friends like this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Doesn't that mean you're just bored and need a toy to play with?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Unfortunately for you, I have nothing to complain or tell you about.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Dang...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I couldn't figure out what was going on with her in the end, but I guess she'll be back to her usual self if she's like this now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, enough about that. Once we're done eating, let's check out that accessory shop we saw back there!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Plus, it's a good chance to get some good pics to post online, and you're gonna help me out.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Fine, sure. Anything you say...
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K, I'm done with the storyboard, so can you take a look? You too, Yuki. I'm curious to hear what you think♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Overall, it seems good.
Maybe except the chorus...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <There's too much going on...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah. You might be right.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hahaha. I guess I did cram too much into that part. I wasn't really sure which ones to go with, so I'll give it another go.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I was hoping to hear what Ena thinks too but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll try drawing something. I don't know if it'll be any good, but I'll try.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Kanade made a song just for Ena, and now she's making artwork just for that song...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wonder how it'll turn out but...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki, I came up with something after seeing Amia's storyboard, but what if the lyrics had keywords that tied into the video?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<That shouldn't be too hard.
But I may need some time...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. Thank you, if you don't mind.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Sure. I'll get back to work and...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait. Hold on one sec!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Hm? Is something wrong...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Once we're done making this song, we're working on that song you made for Enanan next, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, that's the plan.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, uh... Sorry... I was just worried about Enanan is all.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, she seems all better now, but she's still sort of recovering too, you know? I was just worried about her relapsing or something...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You really care about Enanan, don't you...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, because she always rushes off and tries to do everything on her own!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I wish she'd talk to us or lean on us more, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <She could at least leave Nightcord on in the background while we talk or something.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That would be nice but...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You know better than anyone else that Enanan doesn't like to ask for advice when it comes to her art, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But... Yeah, you're right...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <She's stubborn, hates to lose and loves art to death...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm guessing she really wants to succeed there on her own.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Right. She may also be testing how far she can go or how long she can keep drawing.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Testing her limits, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But that reminds me of when Enanan said that she's too scared to draw or didn't feel like it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <*Sigh*... I get what she wants to do, but I still want to know if there's anything we can do for her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You guys feel the same way, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <No. We dealt with it in SEKAI...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I feel the same way. I put everything I wanted to tell her into that song.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But one thing I may want to tell her is to listen to that song the next time she gets stuck somewhere...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I see... You believe in Enanan's ability to make it through this, K...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Don't you too, Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh? I mean, yeah. I do but...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <For now, I think that's all we can do.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Fine, I guess all we can do right now is wait for her...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (You can do it, Ena! We'll be waiting for you!)
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. One awesome itinerary hot off the press♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We'll get to learn a little more about each other and maybe get Kanade out of her slump. Two birds with one stone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I hope they like it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't really tell them since it's a mystery tour and all...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, that could work♪
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Morning, An!
Or good afternoon, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey. Morning, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You seem pretty happy today.
Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm going on a little trip during the next holiday with some people I know♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I even came up with what feels like a pretty good plan but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Could you take a look too, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me? I don't mind, but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, lemme send you a copy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, got it. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
W-Wait, hold on...!
These places are all haunted...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm taking everybody on a mystery tour and thought we could hit up these places♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Like this tunnel. What do you think? It totally looks like somewhere you'd see a real ghost, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
S-Sure...?
Wait, real ghosts...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. That's one of the photos even someone like you can handle, An. There's others where you can clearly see "them"...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wanna take a look?
They're pretty good..

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: N-N-N-No way!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahahaha!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't know how the others feel about ghosts and stuff, but I hope we can all see a part of each other that we usually don't.)

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Oh... Look, it's that first-year...

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: You're right. I can't tell at all...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Huh? Are they talking about...?
No, just ignore them...)

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Uh oh, run!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And what if going to see all these places ends up getting you cursed or something?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What was that? I thought you believe in this stuff, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ghosts and curses are completely different things. I'm just saying that you might want to be careful.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. If you say so.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But thanks, An...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here, I'll buy you a drink to return the favor!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? I'm holding you to that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Of course♪
How about I go right now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, now?
But afternoon classes are about to start?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't worry!
I'll make sure that I get something you really like, but it might take me a while too, so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm? Does that mean...?
You're cutting class?!
Get back here, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Let's see. I'll have to brush up on my travel plans when I get home♪)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I-Is that...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yo! Li'l bro!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Akiyama... Would you please stop calling me that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aww, but that's what you really are...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, also! I'm going on a trip with your sister and some friends.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If it looks like she's forgotten or wants to sleep in on the day of, can you wake her up for me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A trip? And why do I have to...?

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line:
Mizuki!
Classes are about to start!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Busted...!
Later, li'l bro! Gotta go now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, that's what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: H-Hey, what's the big idea?! I can't run... No, get home if you get in my way like that...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Go home? Afternoon classes are about to start, so you should at least attend them since you're here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nooo!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Good work, Akito!
We've got you now, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Li'l bro betrayed me!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who said I was on your side?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And you, An!
You sprinted down the corridor! Aren't you supposed to be enforcing rules instead of breaking them?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's okay as long as I'm on the job.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, how have you gotten away with missing so many days? You know you might actually get held back, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. I really doubt that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'm happy that you want me to be in the grade as you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Just for you, An, I'll show up for classes this afternoon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, please do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm heading back to my class then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right! Let's go too, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's go!
A few days after the trip
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, I think I got everything that I wanted to do finished... I'm logging off now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. Bye, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Bye, Enanan!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. Bye...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What am I doing...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I always thought that I couldn't...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It never ended up working out...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Even though I really want to be with them next year too, there's a part of me that thinks it won't work out...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (You said that you wanted to learn more about everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it turns out that I'm the one keeping the most secrets...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I do honestly hope that we're all still together like this next year...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha...
The next day
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Morning!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Morning, Mizuki!
You're never here this early. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, nothing♪
I wake up early sometimes too, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If only you could do that every day...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, how'd your trip go?
Did everything turn out okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was super fun!
My haunted mystery tour was a big hit!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Everyone looked like they were actually scared and had some good reactions. Oh, except nothing really fazed this one girl.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's great!
Especially since you put so much time into that plan of yours.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Also...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, what's our next class?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Modern Japanese. Did you bring your textbook?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup, it's right here♪ I feel like learning something for a change, so I think I'll actually participate today.
Lunch Break

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's finally lunchtime. Such a long day...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: An, let's go get lunch!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Oh, Mizuki, are you getting anything?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah. I'm not all that hungry so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You sure? Okay then...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Maybe I should head up to the rooftop. Then I might feel...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Why did I just think that he'd be up there now...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Things are different now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*... I guess I'll just go back and sleep at my desk.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki...?
After school
Kamiyama High School - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello, Mizuki. Are you on your way home?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, yup♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's rare to see you stay like this until classes end.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. A certain someone in my class is a hall monitor and she guilted me into staying.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, what were you up to during lunch...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? During lunch?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seemed like you wished to speak with me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Oh, that?
We just happened to pass each other.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is that so...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, hold on.
Would I ever lie to you, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm heading home now, so bye♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll be waiting on the rooftop again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup!
Later♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: See you...
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Humhumhuuum♪
I got me a super cute dress♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The lace pattern on the midriff looks a little clunky, but I guess I can just fix that myself...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So it's off to the sewing lounge!
I hope there's space... Hm, is that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, it's not this way either...
The map said there should be an alley here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, it's Shizuku...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Shizuku!
We haven't seen each other since our picnic, have we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Mizuki!
Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm trying to get to this place here on the map, but I'm not sure how. Would you happen to know, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sure, let's see... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Uh, Shizuku...
This is a map of London...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I know!
I'm trying to find a store called London...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I looked up London and Map and this was what I found so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, now I get it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Shizuku...
This map won't get you to the store you're looking for. It's not even a map of Shibuya...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's a map of London, UK, you see...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...
Sewing Lounge

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Who would've thought that we were actually headed for the same place?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And this place being named Lond and not London probably didn't help either...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I didn't know that you liked embroidering, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, my grandmother taught me how.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's so cool! Do you ever make your own clothes and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure that I can, but I'm not very good with sewing machines or machines in general. I think that's why I prefer embroidery more since its much simpler...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So today, I'd like to finish making this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A handkerchief with... Is that someone's name...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I plan to give everyone in my group one. Each will have their own name and MORE MORE JUMP! sewn into them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This one's for Haruka...
I'm having their names be in their own color, but our group name will have the same design.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, that's amazing...! The letters are so tiny! You even gave your group name a cool color gradient too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
It was worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope your alterations go well too, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks! It's time to give this thing a cute makeover!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Shizuku, is my sewing machine being too loud?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, you're fine. I actually kind of like that sound.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It reminds me of how my grandmother used to make clothes for me and my little sister. It's very nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She did? That's really nice of her!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Speaking of which, did someone teach you how to sew and do alterations like this, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I learned it all on my own by looking up stuff, watching videos and copying what people did online.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You learned to do all this by yourself? That's incredible!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah, this is nothing...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, by the way...
Did you know that there's a nice, little handicraft shop with a fairly large selection here in Shibuya?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: One of my little sister's childhood friends told me about it, and I always seem to find myself completely immersed in all the threads and fabrics they have available.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You mean the place on the second floor of that one building? Yeah, I go there all the time!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I didn't realize Shizuku and I had this much in common!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Phew... Finally, it's done!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, the lace on the midriff looks very nice. Almost as if a professional made it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Replacing that bit was a challenge, but I'm glad that it turned out as cute as I hoped it would...♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How'd yours go, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Very well. I have one for each member of my group now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Can I see...?
Oh, I like what you did with the reverse side! This is so nice...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's my thanks for everything they've done for me until now. Each stitch represents just how much I appreciate them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you can really tell too!
Honestly, I'm pretty jealous that everyone in your group gets to have one of these...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh? In that case...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you like to have this one?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I actually brought an extra handkerchief, and worked on it hoping to give it to you once I was done.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It has my name and a blue bird with a ribbon embroidered in...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This bird's wearing the same ribbon as me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A-Are you sure, Shizuku? I can really have this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course. You helped me find this place and I had a wonderful time with you today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It would make me very happy if you accept it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow...! Thanks, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, by the way...
I get the ribbon motif, but why a blue bird?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really like little birdies and are probably my favorite thing to embroider. Also...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's symbolizes my hope that you'll find your way to happiness, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It does...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't know what to say. Thank you so much, Shizuku. I promise to take good care of this...!
Kamiyama High School - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Yawn*... So sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really didn't want to come to school today, but my attendance has been getting pretty bad too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Worse if the teachers start coming after me about it... Hm?
*Whirr*...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? What was that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That's weird... I thought I heard Rui's drone flying around, but was it something else?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Finally, lunch...!
Why do classes have to be so long?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyways, I should go get something as a little reward... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Long time no see.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Toya! Li'l bro! What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you heading towards the store too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I need to hurry before they run out of what I want♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong, li'l bro?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I told you to stop calling me that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But Ena told me about that picnic you all went on and how you saved her...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, that?
Yeah, I swooped in to save the day!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
To be fair, I wasn't alone.
I was actually with...!
Hello there! I was just looking for you...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: K-Kamishiro...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's been a while.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. First and second years really don't get many opportunities to interact with one another.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyways, I made something that you may find interesting. I was hoping to show it to you all today if you don't mind coming along with me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You in particular, Aoyagi. This may actually interest you the most.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Huh? Me?
If that's the case...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, but we were just about to get lunch! Let's go, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? A-Akito...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Don't leave me, li'l bro...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Shall we, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Uh, sure...
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So what is it that you plan on doing? Just no explosions and stuff, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, nothing like that.
Here, take a look.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What is this? I see a big button attached to a speaker so... Is it a safety alarm for kids or something...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're mostly on the right track.
Why not try pressing it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hold on... That usually means something bad's gonna happen. Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm sure. It'll just make a sound.
Please, feel free to press it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Just a sound? Well, if that's all then...
Here goes... Nothing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Ha ha ha ha ha!!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?! Wait, is that Tsukasa's voice?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Go on! Press it again!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh, okay... Again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Whaaat?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: He said something different! What is this thing?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Tenma, written as soaring pegasus!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Wonderhoy!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! Seriously, what is this thing?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <The one destined to become a star! His name is...!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Razzle Dazzle Sunny Funny☆>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahahaha!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This is really him?!
How many lines are there?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now I have to hear all of them!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, my sides... You made me laugh so hard...! You still haven't answered my question. What is this thing...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's an experimental prop for a show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've been thinking about how to use it and one might be to emulate instant transmission...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Instant transmission?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We could plant these within the audience and play them to draw attention away from the stage. During that time, cast members can appear or disappear as they like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's a little dull now that you've explained it... You think that'll actually work?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It'll depend on how and when we use them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Again, they're still experimental, so it may be a while until we use them in an actual show.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see. I kept thinking it was just a toy or something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That thought did occur to me as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It looks so innocent and pointless, but I believe that it can make people laugh without much effort.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Wait...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Did he make this for me...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll be waiting on the rooftop again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Have you been waiting all this time for me...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, not at all. I've been flying a drone that tells me if you'd be coming up here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I knew it... That sound I heard earlier was his drone...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you ever feel the need to laugh for no reason whatsoever, I can lend this to you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll feel better if you do.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, you might be right...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Thanks, Rui.)
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for today, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't mention it, really!
Get home safe, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I will. I'll see you on Nightcord later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm glad Kanade feels a little better now.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But still...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: C'mon, Mizuki... What are you doing...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You did the same thing when you went on that picnic with Ena and her friends...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Always getting so involved...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But deep down, I know.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I like them a lot.
Ena, Kanade, Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can't just leave them alone if it looks like they need help. I usually find myself looking for a way to help them.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wouldn't mind just basking in this for a while...)
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Oh, right. It's a weekday.
I might've been at school if I bothered to put on my uniform.)

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The diner we go to for after parties...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here you go, Kanade. Your oolong tea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And what did you get, Mizuki?
It's not a color I'm used to seeing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, this? Heh heh heh.
It's a special cocktail of a lot of different stuff. Wanna try it? It's good♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way. It looks gross.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, the color isn't great, but it really is pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mizuki, your fries are going cold.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, good call! Thanks, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, wanna try some of this too while you're at it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No. I wouldn't know how it tastes anyway...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You sure? Suit yourself.
How about you, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm okay too.
I don't really like carbonated drinks to begin with so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. But I can also drink it just fine once it's gone flat.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're kidding, right?! It'd be just sugar water at that point!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, that did happen...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It almost feels nostalgic too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It wasn't actually that long ago. Why am I reminiscing like it was...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What does this mean...? It's like, in my mind, I'm already trying to make it something of the past...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (How long will this last...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Am I gonna be all alone again...?)
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's starting to rain again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I hope Kanade got home safe.
I'd hate to see her get all soaked again.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You know what, forget the umbrella...
I'm going home just like this...
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <A... Achoo!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Amia, can you at least move away from your mic if you know you're about to sneeze?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Sorry...
That one came pretty quick.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh geez... Did you catch a cold or something?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, maybe.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It all started after that day I ran into K and hung out with her...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<K, how do you feel?
You were walking around in the rain when I first saw you and it started raining after we split.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, but I'm okay.
It started raining just as I got home.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I also put on a bath and gave myself some time to think about the melody for this song while I took a dip.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Really? Thank goodness!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But it sounds like you got drenched, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You did? But you had an umbrella, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oops...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
