rows.Line: <About that! You know that musical where that guy sings while it's pouring outside?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The weather reminded me of that and I felt like copying him...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? You're joking, right? That means you did this to yourself.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha! Yup!
Achoo...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Again...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sorry, okay... I covered my mouth this time at least...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's the least you could do. The best is to just mute yourself.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Okay, princess. I will when I can...
A... A-Achoo!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Way to mute yourself.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, I tried!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <You don't seem sick besides that, Amia. Are you running a fever at all?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No, not really.
Just a lot of sneezing.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It could just be the start of a cold then. You might be able to avoid the worst of it if you take some medicine now...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'd like to do that... But all the cold medicine at my house is that powder stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What's wrong with that? It'll help, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But it's so bitter! Isn't there a better way to fix this?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You could steep some ginger in hot water...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <When I was little, that's what my mom usually made for me...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure I would've been able to handle what I just felt if I came here alone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was able to look back on what happened then with a more open mind thanks to you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Kanade...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She put honey in it too, so it actually tasted really nice.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I'll try that!
Ginger's supposed to be good for you too, so I'll give it a shot!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, is it true that wrapping green onions around your head fixes colds?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Who knows...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <There's research out there that says the allicin in green onions carries antimicrobial properties and can help keep your nose and throat healthy...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But you apparently have to mash or grind the green onions to release the allicin with its cells into the air...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, doesn't that mean you have to keep sniffing green onions 24/7 for that to work...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Eww. That might be a bit much...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then why don't you just take whatever medicine you have, Amia? You know it's going to work and it'll be a lot easier.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Ugh... I don't have a choice, do I?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*... Okay, I'll do it.
But I'll also try that ginger tea K mentioned to get rid of the bitter awfulness!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And please rest too. There's no need to rush anything you're working on right now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They all seem genuinely concerned for me. That makes me feel kinda happy...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They actually care about me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Amia, you still there?
Get to bed soon, alright?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I will...
Thanks, you guys!>
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
How's this...?!
No, I missed...! I can't hit anything...!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You're an awful shot, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, she even got the toughest one! Why didn't you tell us you were so good at this, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm not. This is my first time.
It's easy. Just point and shoot.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, that wasn't directed at me, was it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? You have to pull this trigger pretty hard, huh...? I can't hit anything, and this thing's heavier than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, since we're all here, wanna check out the rest of the festival together?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I really thought I was having fun then...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So why is it that it feels like there's this great big hold in my heart...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ugh... It's my teacher...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki here♪
What's up, teach?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? I have to go in for supplementary classes again? I could've sworn that I showed up enough this time to not have to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hold on, tomorrow...?!
But tomorrow's Sun...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, I'll go. I'm sorry for making you waste your day off like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What's the point of studying...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But there's nothing to do here either. I guess school wins by default...)
The next day
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Yawn*...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I left early to make sure I get to school in time, but man, this is such a pain...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I'll take a little detour while I'm at it.
Center Street

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Nooo! It's too early!
Nothing's open yet!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess I'll just go kill some time at the bookstore...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Akiyama?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, good morning.
You're in your uniform... Are you on your way to school?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, they're making me take supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
How about you?
What brings you here so early? Without Li'l Bro too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's not like I'm always with Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We actually just finished our morning practice and have some free time now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What? Morning practice?
This early?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, well... It should take place in the morning, no...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, but... I mean...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You guys must really love singing if you're willing to get up this early to practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we do.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm hardly ever at school, so we haven't really talked much but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I never knew he could smile and laugh like this.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And as you already know, Akito, my dad has been teaching me classical music since I was only a few years old.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, he was extremely strict...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He made me practice before going to school and after coming home until it was time for bed. On weekends, I had to spend the entire day playing the piano and violin.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the time I started middle school, I couldn't stand it anymore. I started thinking about finding a way out...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I still don't know Toya's whole story, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Good for you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's great that you found something you really love doing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm glad as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, thanks to Akito and the others, I was able to talk to my dad about what I'm doing now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Before, every time I went home, we always ended up fighting and arguing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I couldn't find the opportunity to tell him how I really felt...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But my teammates managed to open that door for me, and I was finally able to talk to him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I even asked him to come to see us perform.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, did he actually go?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I believe so.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After that, well... He's still more or less stone-faced, but we don't fight anymore...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad that I can pursue the path I actually want to now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I was happy that I was able to get him to understand that I have a dream and not care if he doesn't approve of it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's pretty cool, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They fought and argued that much, but he still had the guts to face his dad and tell him how he really felt.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (He never gave up on what he loves doing and actually got through to his dad...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll try drawing something. I don't know if it'll be any good, but I'll try.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Trying and not giving up, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akiyama...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Oh... What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's just, I was wondering what it is that you like to do is all, Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've gotten to know each other a little better, but we haven't really talked about our hobbies, dreams and such until now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right. That's true.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What do I like to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, I'd like to stay and chat a little longer, but I gotta get to class soon...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
Sorry for keeping you like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, it's totally okay. I was the one that started asking a bunch of questions first, so... Later!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we do.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Talk about bailing out there. I doubt Toya isn't bothered by it, but that was pretty lame of me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But we were talking about hobbies and stuff so... Why didn't I just say that I like designing clothes or something like that?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (No, that might've just gone over his head...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I mean, he has nothing to hide and just lets everything out into the open...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's like... I was almost at the point of wanting to speak the truth too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, pull yourself together!
Get your butt to school already!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm beat...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It felt like they made me do a year's worth of studying today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I could stop by a cafe for a sweet reward...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? That voice... Toya?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I guess he's in the middle of singing practice...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But he just practiced this morning. He's back at it again?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: He's so serious about it too. I guess he just really loves to sing, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I probably shouldn't bother him right now. Plus, I'm exhausted from school, so let's get home...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A-Akiyama...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: H-Hey, Li'l Bro!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (He came out of nowhere! What is it with me running into people today?!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Or maybe I should've expected this since he's probably here to practice with Toya at the park!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're in your uniform. Were you at school today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh, yeah. Supplementary classes, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Are you here to meet up with Toya?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, how'd you know? Did you see him?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I saw him on my way to school after you guys just finished your morning practice. I even saw him in the park just now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Are you guys here to meet up and do another practice together, Li'l Bro?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. We're meeting as a team and heading over to an event right after.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Wait, does that mean An and Kohane are coming too?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, they are... Hold on, you know about Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
An's told me all about her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I even got to meet her during the School Festival.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah, alright.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's kinda weird to think that you're singing with them, Li'l Bro...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, this all sort of just happened, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We found ourselves singing all together this one time, and something just clicked.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Us all having the same dream helped too, probably.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, An told me about that too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Something about putting on an event that's better than the one An's dad put on, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's so cool.
You guys really are all working towards the same goal.

rows.Speaker: Akito

By the time I woke up, I was in the hospital.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What do you mean, “Yes, I did”...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I've been worried that you'd get sick one day eating nothing but instant noodles... But it has already happened.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <No better than fasting, to be honest.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I've been more careful lately.
I know that instant noodles alone aren't enough, so I make sure to take vitamin drinks and eat nutrient-rich foods now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <On top of that, having a housekeeper clean and cook delicious food for me has been an enormous help.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's right. You two had already met by then.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I initially met her while she was still just observing, but she was the one who discovered that I was in trouble...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That means she's the one who saved you, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. My grandma even said that there must be some meaning in us meeting.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hold on, Yuki, doesn't that girl go to your school?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes, she does.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, really?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You don't remember?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A girl from my club that I talk to often told me her friend works as domestic help.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, what? You talk to people at school?
What's she like?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know how to describe her... Her name's Shizuku Hinomori, and she's a famous idol, but I don't really know about the things she does outside school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hold on a sec!
Shizuku Hinomori who used to be the front girl of Cheerful * Days?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, she quit that group, no?
I had no idea she was in the same school as Mafuyu. Nice!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, now I remember...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That means you knew about Kanade's housekeeper too, right, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes, but only because Hinomori was already acquainted with her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But then, you finally met her through one of her bandmates!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That was also because Ms. Mochizuki suggested that we meet.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She's such a kind, thoughtful and gentle person.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I'm glad...
I'd like to meet her someday.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Because then, I'll be able to ask her in person!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Ask what?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Nothing other than, “Please, keep an eye on Kanade for us!”>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. Hey, let's be honest. K's eating right because of her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, we've been on this tangent long enough. Tell us more about what happened after you two met, K, Yuki!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, what happened after you collapsed?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um... They ran tests to check for abnormalities, put me on an IV and sent me home afterward...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What?! That's it?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, and after I got home...>
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What?! Crap, it's already 6:00 am!
And the sun's already coming up...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What's that, Enanan? You forgot about what you were doing because you were too interested in their story?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Shut up!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I guess that's it for today.
Why don't we head back to SEKAI?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay. That was fun.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Night, Miku, Luka...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hearing about how Kanade and Mafuyu met was nice...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Also, I had no idea they both had to go through so much...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I mean, Kanade literally pushed herself by composing until she became completely exhausted...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (While Mafuyu started getting more and more lost in terms of who she really is...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Despite all odds, they kept going...
And they found each other.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's pretty unbelievable.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They're both still carrying some of that pain, but they're also looking for ways to move forward...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's like they're trying to show each other the way down this long, dark path.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're wrong!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't want to keep seeing you like this, Mizuki, because whatever you're going through is starting to affect me too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's normal to want to help out a friend when they're in need.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So please, tell me when you feel you're ready. I'll be waiting until then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Showing each other the way forward, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess that means my <K> is...)

rows.Line: (Something simple that doesn't really imply anything is probably my safest bet.)

rows.Line: (Kanade and Mafuyu went out of their way to get me chocolates, so I kinda want to give back something nice.)

rows.Line: (Chocolates of different shapes and sizes for each person would be ideal...)

rows.Line: But I'd need a bunch of different ingredients and cookware to make that happen.

rows.Line: Hmm... What else would be good...?

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Let's see... The “Chocolate Factory”?

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Wait, we can use all the ingredients and cookware that are there?! And we can make them how we like?! This is it!

rows.Line: <Um... Sometime before White Day if possible, so... This weekend!>

rows.Line: <Oh, this weekend...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Do you have practice? Or an event?>

rows.Line: <There's also that, but I promised to help out at our place this weekend...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's too bad. I guess business is business.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Sorry. Hey, hold on.
Why don't you invite Akito's sister?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I have a feeling that she won't want to be bothered with something like this...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Who else do you think would want to go?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Hmm... What about Kamishiro?
You two are pretty close, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Rui? He'd probably be more interested in machinery than chocolate.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, his troupe usually has practice on weekends, so I doubt he'll be free to go on such short notice.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Then, why not Akito?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <He likes sweets, so he might be willing to go.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I see your point...
You really think he'll want to go?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Won't he just say the same thing as Ena? He probably won't want to bother with something like this.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <I mean, they're doing chocolate-making demos for White Day, right?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Despite the way he talks, he's pretty old-fashioned. I have a feeling he's still figuring out what to give back, so he might want to go. Who knows?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Also... This Chocolate Factory sells its own chocolates, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah... Oh, I almost forgot. The ad said this famous chocolatier names Paul Hansen is supposed to be visiting.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It even mentioned how participating in the demo gives you an opportunity to buy his latest creations.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Really?! That means you can buy chocolates for yourself and make some for White Day! Two birds with one stone!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <There's no way Akito can say no to that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Interesting. I didn't realize Li'l Bro liked sweets that much.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Thanks, An.
I'll try asking him if Ena says she isn't up to it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, sorry for taking so much time out of your lunch break.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<No problem!
Call me again if something comes up, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I will! Bye bye♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena or Li'l Bro... It should be fun either way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hold on. I don't have to just invite one of them. Why not both? I could invite Toya along too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't wait to see how things turn out. First, I'll ask Ena to see what she thinks♪
White Day
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Line: Morning, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki!
Fancy seeing you here in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! I ran into Li'l Bro just now and he said the exact same thing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I need to be here today since it's White Day♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa! Happy White Day!
My thanks for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Mizuki

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! Tenma was supposed to perform in this show as an extra but his mascot partner couldn't stop crying?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we weren't sure what was gonna happen at first.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But Tsukasa and I worked together to make chocolates with all the little kids, while Li'l Bro helped our mascot friend settle down...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It was a total frenzy but really fun at the same time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool. I would've loved to see how you and Akito acted!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I didn't say much, but Li'l Bro was a pro♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The way he went all out with his bright and cheerful big brother persona was so great!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For more on that, you should probably ask him yourself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I think I will when we get together for practice later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, thanks for the chocolates.
And bravo, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can't thank you enough for treating me like a normal person...)

rows.Line: (Ena still didn't seem that satisfied, but we finally get to take a breather.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I hope she gets to relax a little during our afterparty...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(They're already here.
But I don't think they've seen me yet.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh...

rows.Speaker: Scout?
rows.Line:
“Whoa, check out you three!
Hey, how would you cuties feel about modeling for a hair salon?”

rows.Speaker: Scout?
rows.Line: “You might get noticed by someone working for a big fashion zine. Who knows?”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: M-Model?! For a fashion magazine?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Nice! Sounds like you're on board♪”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki, it's you. For a second there, I thought...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Geez, you're the worst...
Even as a joke, that's pretty low.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you seemed so excited, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I saw that look on your face.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me? Who wouldn't be excited? I can ignore some dimwit hitting on me, but someone calling themselves a veteran scout's a completely different story.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that, but who else among us would get all giddy about something like this?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd refuse flat out.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too... I'd probably run, literally...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh? Neither of you were interested in what this “scout” had to say?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which means this little lie was planned with me in mind from the start, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Uh, well...
Hey, the light just turned green! Let's cross♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Mizuki, wait! We're not done here!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ena seems much better now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: As obnoxious as ever too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! I heard that, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, just chill.
C'mon, Kanade, Mafuyu, let's go!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here's to another job well done!
Cheers♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu & Kanade
rows.Line: Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To apologize for my little stunt earlier, Ena, I'll buy you any dessert of your choosing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? You mean it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unless you don't want anything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, a giant parfait might do the trick.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Can't you show me some pity?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Were you working on a painting before you got here, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? How did you know?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Your sleeve. There's some paint on it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way! Ugh... It's just a drop, but you're right. It must've gotten on me when I was cleaning up...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Luckily, you should be able to wash that off no problem.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You were working on another painting today?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. The only way for me to learn how to be more expressive is by drawing and painting as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's gonna be a long process, but I don't plan on quitting any time soon.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
From time to time, Ena...
You become this absolutely incredible person.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I understand what Mizuki means.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No one asked you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Actually studying art, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Kanade and Mafuyu keep finding new ways to express themselves, and Ena's really starting to hit the books.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That means I can't drag my feet.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Especially since all their work goes to waste if my videos aren't really up to snuff.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'll get some books and stuff to learn more about editing videos!)
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I know I need to keep my attendance up, but a whole day of classes is so exhausting.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Still, once homeroom's over...)

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: We'll now be choosing cheer squad members for the Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The Sports Festival's one thing, but the cheer squad? I'd rather pass if it means standing out more than I need to...)

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: Since no one put their name in during our last homeroom, our class will be drawing straws.

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: Please say so if you draw a straw with “winner” in red letters written on it. Form a single-file line to the right and wait to draw your straw.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yikes... I've gotta get mine now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Please, not me...
What...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mizuki? Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, hey! Looks like Akiyama drew one.

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line:
Alright, that's our first winner.
Everyone else, please keep checking to see what you get.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Grr... And I keep missing out on that anime song concert too... Why's my luck so rotten...?!

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: Shiraishi, you're up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, let's see...
Nope, not me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Hmm... But it could be fun to be on the cheer squad with Mizuki during the Sports Festival...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
O-Oh no...
I... I can't be on the cheer squad...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line:
That's all the straws.
There should be one other winner out there. Who drew it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, me! I'm the last one!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A-An?!

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: Ah, Shiraishi. Understood.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Man, An drew the short straw too.
I guess we can lick each other's wounds while griping about our bad luck.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Um, Shiraishi...
Are you really sure about taking my place?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I actually kinda wanted to be on the cheer squad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And not everybody's cut out for stuff like this, right? I really don't think there's any need to force yourself into doing anything for the Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So you can leave the cheering to me!
But in return, promise to do your best during the other events!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
O-Okay...!
I should be able to do that for at least the ball toss!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great! That's the spirit!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So An took their place.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Um... Thank you so much, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, I should be the one thanking you!
Now I get to enjoy the Sports Festival with Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: Thank you for your cooperation, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: The representatives for our class have been decided, but the cheer squad is always looking for more recruits. Please feel free to ask to join at any time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, looks like we're both on the cheer squad now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. I guess the Sports Festival won't be as boring as having to sit through classes just to keep up my attendance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! I really doubt you'll be bored. I mean, our school's cheering competition's supposed to be pretty famous!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So let's do our best to make the Sports Festival really fun this year!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, okay...
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What to do about that thing Rui asked me to do...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? A video of a fire?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. You saw that amongst the Captain's list of ideas, right? The one where we'd twirl weapons around as we jump into a fire.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, you mentioned how it could be done using a video instead.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I mean, yeah...
But how do you plan on jumping into a video of a fire?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What if we jump out from behind whatever screen it's being shown on? No, that may look a bit too surreal...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'll give that a little more thought.
After all, it's a part of my job as the director.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I'd like you to focus on making that video for us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, got it♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Fire... Flames...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (My initial impression involved a flame that crackled away as its flames rose into the sky...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I get a whole screen to work with, so it might be better to have it twist and whirl.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I have a few ideas for that already...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it has to be a fire that we can jump into while twirling weapons around...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hang on... Why are we jumping into it at all? Do the weapons mean we're about to go into battle?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I should've asked to borrow that sheet of paper when Rui came to talk to me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But for now, I'll just keep coming up with different patterns and ideas...!
The next day - Lunch break
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, this isn't it either...
And this one... Wrong notes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Here is it, Mizuki.
This one has that idea about jumping through fire written on it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that!
Thanks for helping me look for it, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, I should've realized this sooner.
My apologies, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? I'm the one who forgot.
You don't have to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: However, if you're still feeling guilty, you can help me come up with more ideas!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Of course.
Speaking of which, have you come up with some already?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! First, we're the blue team, so I thought it'd be cool to have a blue flame...
After School

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Toya!
Off to the library?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I haven't been there much, so mind if I tag along? Also, there's this book I'm trying to find...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Awesome! Now that I have all the info and materials I need, I can try putting a storyboard together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This is supposed to take place right after the Captain makes his entrance as Liu Bei, so the flame's gonna need to draw everyone's attention at that moment.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the flame itself needs to really roar since it's supposed to represent Liu Bei's determination.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, the book about the Three Kingdoms that Toya recommended said more about what he was like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Based on what this book says... He wasn't much of a talker and didn't really smile or laugh much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is that why Rui's script didn't include many lines?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... I should probably keep reading to get a better idea of how to get this flame to look right.
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (First, I'll give it a powerful look that exudes a sense of steadfast resolve...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Next, a warm flame that can envelops and encourages everyone that comes near it...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Phew... Okay, I have a way better idea of what to do now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But the BGM...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I still can't find any music that goes with this flame and changes its tempo at the right spots...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, it's Kanade.
I guess she's back from having dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Maybe I should ask her...
But it has nothing to do with our group...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I could send a DM...
That way, she can decide whether or not to look at it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K, I'm making this video for myself and am looking for songs that goes with this storyboard. Know any?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know it has nothing to do with what our group does, so you don't have to do this if you don't want to♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm... Hm...?!
Whew...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The cheering competition's one thing, but practicing for the other events is also starting to take its toll.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I should probably take a bath and do whatever else to stay in good shape...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, it's from Kanade...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, she looked at my storyboard!
She even included a link to a video site...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Kanade!
You're the best!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see what kind of song she suggested♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I was so bummed out at first when I got picked for the cheer squad...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But this is actually getting to be pretty fun.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess that straw was right about me being the “winner”.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. That means I'm gonna need to produce a good video that helps us win the cheering competition♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let's do this!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whew! That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I had fun too...!
Whizzing around on those rides was so amazing.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I agree. I was a bit startled, but we also got to see some beautiful sights.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm glad you guys liked it, but I could really go for a quick break now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm going to get something to drink...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, go for it♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena, Kanade, there's a nice bench just over there, so let's wait for Mafuyu there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, sounds good...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You two, okay?
Was that roller coaster a bit too much?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, it's not that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I hadn't gone on it such a long time...
I kept asking myself, “Was this thing always so scary?”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! To be fair, it got a bit of a facelift to make it more thrilling than before!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While we screamed our lungs out, Mafuyu just sat there like nothing was happening.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, not knowing what she's thinking is sort of par for the course, but I feel like she's been spacing out a lot today, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree... Could it be that skipping her practice exam is bothering her more than we realize?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But she came all this way to join us, so I really want her to have some fun at least...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, where is she...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? It hasn't been that long, but maybe she's waiting in line to make her purchase.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Waiting in line...? I see two or three people tops... There, look...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm? Whoa, you're right!
The shop's literally right there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
So, Mafuyu's...
Not in line there it seems.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, I remember now!
I think she went off in the other direction...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Seriously, where's her head at today...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But for now, let's just give her a little more time and be patient. I'm sure Miku and Len are with her too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Are you worried about her, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Today's one thing, but she was also acting a bit strange the last time we spoke in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Her mom found out that she saved that synthesizer and was still using it, which probably led to a really unpleasant conversation...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And when we met up with her today...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The way she said, “I don't know...” She seems totally conflicted and unable to think clearly.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I know Miku and Len are with her, but given her current state, maybe it isn't such a good idea to leave her alone right now.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, I'm gonna try looking for Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you're gonna look for her...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll be fine. I just have to call her and ask about her general surroundings...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm? I just got a message...
Oh, it's from Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really?! What'd she say?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She said... <I think I'm lost.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're kidding, right?
She's a high-schooler, not some little kid...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's cut her some slack for now.
Kanade, mind telling her to just stay put? Also, can you ask about what she sees around her?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, will do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ugh...
Alright, let's find her together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's great and all, but are you two sure you don't want to rest for a bit longer?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm okay now, Mizuki, but I appreciate the thought.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Same. If anything, waiting around is starting to make my blood boil.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu just replied...
So, it sounds like she's close to Phenny's shop.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I think I remember seeing it while we made our way towards the roller coaster!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, Mafuyu's waiting for us, so let's get a move on!

rows.Speaker: Ena & Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There probably isn't a whole lot I can do, but I wanna do what I can for Mafuyu...)
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I like the expressions we have on our faces in this picture! And the illuminations in this one are good too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Phoenix Wonderland was so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What else was there...? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Mafuyu's completely deadpan in this one...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And Mafuyu didn't really seem to enjoy herself much in the end...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I suppose there wasn't much we could do since her mind was focused on skipping her practice exam and what her mom was going to think.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If we get another chance to go again, I want her to genuinely have fun.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I've fiddled with these photos long enough, so it's phone call time♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
<Thank you for calling!
This is Rui Kamishiro, the director of Wonderlands×Showtime.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Lightning, explosions and pop-up devices are my forte. Indoors or out, I guarantee to bring you the greatest show imaginable. What sort of production do you have in mind?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hehe...!
Haha. What's with the spiel...?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Is it supposed to be your Wonderlands×Showtime sales pitch?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <No, I decided to throw you a curveball since it's so rare for you to call me like this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, you came up with that on the spot? Nice.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Hehe. Anyway, how can I help you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I wanted to thank you for those tickets! I really appreciate you giving them to me and everybody in my group really enjoyed our little trip.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <That's good to hear.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Speaking of which, you were there to see our show, no? I wish I could've gone to greet you all, but we had to do the night show...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, that's okay. It was super fun!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Th-That's incredible...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah! She's doing cartwheels so fast!
Back to back too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, Otori's in the gymnastics club...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That explains why she's so good at doing cartwheels.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
She's in the dance and swimming clubs too...
And apparently, she helps with the softball team from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Ena
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That girl from Miya Girls and that childhood friend of yours were really cute and cool too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, I thought Tsukasa was supposed to be the protagonist in all your shows, but I was surprised to see that wasn't the case.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Yes, he's the face of our troupe, but we're always looking to use new ideas and variations in our shows.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I didn't know that!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, that reminds me! The girl who did all those amazing cartwheels! I remember meeting her once before!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I decided to try and talk to her because I thought her fashion sense was kind of interesting, but I had no idea that she was your friend, Rui...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Hehe. Emu occasionally visits our school, so you may actually get another chance to see her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, if I'm actually at school...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <By the way, she was wondering if her senior had fun. Do you know if they did?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <I think she spotted them during the night show but couldn't get a clear look at their face.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<So, Mafuyu... Oh, her senior...
She was there after dealing with some personal troubles.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Normally, she'd never get so disoriented, but she was really distraught by what had happened...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I was a little bummed out by that...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, I'm hoping when we go next time that it'll be under better circumstances and we can all have fun.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Hehe. Then, we'll need to get ready by putting a nice polish on our shows.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Thanks! I really appreciate it!>
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
I slept really well...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's noon already?
Haha. I must've been more tired than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, I worked on the finishing touches for our music video until around dawn...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Oh, I should include the ones showing the cherry blossom tree by that abandoned school. Also, some pics of when I went on that picnic with Shizuku and the others♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... It's definitely a possibility, so I should choose pictures that show me smiling and having fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, let's review my current selection...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Line: (During the Sports Festival, and when we went to PXL...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
