rows.Line:
Happy birthday...
I can't actually tell, but I'm guessing this means quite a lot to you, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: At least, that's what it seemed like when we celebrated in SEKAI... Anyway, I'll see you later on Nightcord...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Mizuki.
Did you have fun during the party at school? I guess I could just ask Akito about how it went...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it seems better to ask you personally, so let me know what it was like sometime. I'll be waiting on Nightcord! See you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Today was such an amazing day.
And I have all of you to thank.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really need to thank Ena and the others.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But...
It might be nice to spend a day like this every so often.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, today is my birthday after all♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really appreciate how you all joined me to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank you all so much!
Just before 25:00
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Is Yuki coming today?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Who knows? She hasn't mentioned anything as far as I can tell...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, Yuki just sent a message.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <I made some adjustments to the lyrics I had you all look at the other day. Please take another look in your own time.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. We'll let you know once we've had a chance to... And send.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I guess Yuki's been working whenever she can...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She could've just told us in voice chat, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <She probably would've if she could, which means today's probably not a good day. Lemme try asking her...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, she replied already!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Sorry, I wanted to at least send over my lyrics. Unfortunately, I need to go to bed early tonight.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you, Yuki. Please get a good night's rest.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Night.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Nighty night...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's a bummer that we can't work together, but I think it's kinda good that she gets to go to bed early now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I've been wondering how she's been able to function with so little sleep, and she stayed up the entire night when she came over to my house...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Right. Our lifestyles might not exactly be what you call “normal”, but sleeping is still important.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You're no exception to that, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I-I'll try to make sure I do...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Promise, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Anyway, what time is it...? Ten minutes until 25:00. I guess we can keep talking for a bit longer.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<By the way, Enanan...
What did your mom say when you suddenly brought over Yuki to your house?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Huh? Honestly, not much.
I think she was more surprised when I brought Airi over.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um... She's the idol who performs alongside Hanasato, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yup! That's her!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, who wouldn't be startled after seeing an idol walk into their house?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, true...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <At the same time, Airi was so polite that my mom had a hard time believing she was in junior high...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Ah, that makes sense.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It must've been hard for her to wrap her head around the fact that Airi's so put together even though she's the same age as you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, pretty much...
Also, you didn't have to put it like that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Hehe.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Still, Enanan, I think that shows just how nice your mom is.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I mean, she essentially let someone whom she'd just met stay at her house.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that's right!
This means we'll have a place to stay in case of an emergency!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hold on, Amia, you're not gonna say that you wanna come over now, are you?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I only did what I did because I was worried about Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I know.
I won't make any sudden requests.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, you won't...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I was totally under the impression that you were gonna say, “I might just come over tomorrow♪” or something.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Me too...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha... You can probably tell based on my appearance, but I'm very delicate. I can't sleep without my trusty pillow.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, I'm not sure I wanna stay over at a place where the owner won't let me borrow her shampoo.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Shampoo...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, why do you know about that?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heh heh heh. Yuki told me.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But sleepovers aside, I kinda want to go over and visit all of your houses.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Enanan's family seems like the gourmet type, so I've gotta think we'd get served some fancy tea and snacks!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? What sort of family do you think we are?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If you came over, Amia, you'd only get chips and orange juice.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<What?! That's so plain!
I want some of the expensive and delicious treats that the Shinonomes are famous for!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Hehe...>
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I don't wanna go to school...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why do they have all these stupid attendance rules...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
But I guess I should go since I have work today.
Lunch break
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Grr... An's busy with committee stuff for all of lunch... After getting myself to come to school too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, in that case...!
Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Aha, found him!
Li'l Bro!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm...? Akiyama. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An's busy with committee stuff, so I decided to go look for someone else to have lunch with...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, Li'l Bro, why are you having bread in class? Where's Toya?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He's also busy with committee stuff.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, I was hoping to scarf down my lunch and take a nap. So, if you don't mind, scram will you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?! You meanie!
We're supposed to be lonely buddies.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, I just remembered something...♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu stayed over at your place the other day, right? I bet you were pretty surprised to see her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, her...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It was pretty rare for Ena to bring a friend over. The last time she did was when Momoi visited.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess you know all this already, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. Including the part about you two trying to lovingly feed each other carrots.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In my defense, she instigated by putting one on my plate first.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She knows that I hate them, which makes her the bad guy, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! That's totally something she'd do!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, I didn't know that you get served the things you don't like.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sometimes. Does your family do things differently?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. I really don't like mushrooms, so my mom usually makes sure there aren't any on my plate.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously...? We're not allowed to be picky at our house.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, Mom usually flavors things in a way that makes them easier to eat.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, that's pretty clever of her!
Your mom is so nice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
She is...
But the glazed carrots she made to other day were too sweet.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I thought you liked sweet stuff.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's not the problem.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Ah, Akiyama, there you are.
We need to talk about your supplementary classes!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aww... But I still haven't had lunch yet.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: It just so happens that I have yet to as well because I had to look for a certain someone. Anyway, you're coming with me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh man...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Just go already...
Here, take this sandwich.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! I can have this?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You haven't had lunch yet, right?
I can just go buy more, so you can have it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: L-Li'l Bro!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I promise to take your side the next time Ena tries to do something mean to you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Akiyama!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: C-Coming!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks for the sandwich, Li'l Bro!
I'll savor every bite!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're welcome.
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This blouse is so frilly and cute, I love it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's pastel, it's got a killer design and it's exactly my style... It's my lucky day!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Even when I'm this tired after school, looking at cute clothes just gives me a second wind.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (While I'm here, I'll have a look what else—)

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High School Student A
rows.Line: Hey. Isn't that that first year?

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High School Student B
rows.Line:
You're right...
Looking at those cutesy clothes again...

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High School Student A
rows.Line: Yeah. And just walking around like that... Wow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(Couldn't they at least say that stuff out of my earshot?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Anyway, I'm not gonna pay them attention.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, you're coming home with me, blouse! I'm so excited to wear this♪

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Whoa... This looks so cute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh... I was hovering over that top too... I would've bought it along with the blouse if it was payday already.)

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Wow, so you like this kind of frilly clothing?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: I, um... I do, actually.

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Hmm... It's not like it looks bad on you, but isn't it a bit too...grown-up?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Aha... I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That's not true! If she did something casual with her hair to offset it, like a half-up half-down ponytail, she'd pull it off so well!)

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: I know! There's this store I know with clothes that would suit you much better. I'm taking you there right now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Excuse me...?!)

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Um... I guess that would be okay.

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Okay! Leave your style in my hands!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(I'm sure that girl's friend meant well...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But that's no way to talk to someone about the things they like.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But the girl was no better! Why didn't she speak up? Grinning and bearing it only leads to pain...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh... I guess not...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (After all, arguing for what you love can be quite hard.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Who knew you can't wear the things you want even when you're living your live conventionally?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Time to go home...
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And the color and the design were amazing, so I went ahead and bought that blouse♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wow, and you said that place is on Main Street? I might go check it out.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<You should!
All their stuff was super cute, you'll love it.>

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Wow, so you like this kind of frilly clothing?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: I, um... I do, actually.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wonder if that girl ended up buying something from the store their friend took them to...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Are you okay, Amia? You've gone quiet all of a sudden.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, I...
I just remembered something.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You did? What?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It was... Um...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It'd be weird to hide it from her, and I know she'll worry for no reason...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The thing is...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What?! What gave her friend the right to decide it didn't suit her when she hadn't even tried it on?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If that were me, I'd help my friend create an outfit that made the blouse work for her! A true friend should look out for you!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hahaha. Enanan, you're a caring friend after all, aren't you?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What do you mean, “after all”? Of course I care about my friends.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Amia, I've finished looking at the storyboard.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Thanks, K! Sorry for asking you to check it when it's not even 25:00 yet.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's no problem. You putting a rush on it really helped us out.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh yeah, K.
You'd be annoyed if someone stuck their nose in your fashion choices, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Huh...? Fashion?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <While you were looking at the storyboard, I was telling Ena about these girls I saw today.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yes! One of them pointed out some clothes she liked, and the other said some negative nonsense and dragged her to another store! Outrageous!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I see...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I don't really know much about fashion, but I guess everyone should just wear what they like.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's what I do, and it lets me be comfortable every day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hahaha. That's the best way to live.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh... My stomach just grumbled...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It is dinnertime. I'm gonna grab something to eat.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Me too. In that case, let's meet back here at 25:00.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okie dokie!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wear what you like... Huh.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If everyone thought like Ena and Kanade, maybe life would be easier for me.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I wish there was a place where you could like the things you like, and no one would criticize you for it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha... Just a silly thought♪
Time to grab dinner and get back to—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...?
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh, why am I in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? Something just rolled this way. What could it be? It's sorta...glowing?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Argh! Wait, what?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Was that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ngh...
What was that ball of light?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, huh?! What is this place?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's some kind of...mall?
*Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Look at this clothes store! It's so cute! And this trendy home decor store next to it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And there's another place opposite! Oh heck, just from the outside I can tell they're my style!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While I'm here, I guess there's no harm taking a peek inside.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yes, it's settled♪
I'll do that while I look for an exit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Starting with the clothes store, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ah, that store was so good. Those clothes were all 100% my style!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I haven't seen anyone else here, let alone any of the staff. This place must be pretty lax.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, not that I mind getting free rein to try on clothes.

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High School Student B
rows.Line:
You're right...
Looking at those cutesy clothes again...

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High School Student A
rows.Line: Yeah. And just walking around like that... Wow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(And there's no one like that around...
It's a relief to not worry who's watching me.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now it's time to to head next door for some home decor♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ooh, they've got this natural aesthetic going that's stylish and also super cute! And look at these little jewelry boxes!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And there's masking tape in all different colors and patterns! I wanna use these in a collage.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And next I'll...
Wait, is that place selling macarons?! With lace designs?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow! And these ones have flowers sandwiched in the middle! These are too cute to eat!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This is too much fun! Every store is more than I could hope for!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's even food, so I might as well just move in.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see, where have I not been yet? Just that clothes store on the corner, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow, on top of all the clothes, it's a gold mine of accessories too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I love this top. It's a gorgeous color, but with a toned-down design. Perfect for accessorizing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehehe. I wonder what would go with it...
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What are those?!
Are they food-shaped accessories?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ooh, I spy a cheesecake necklace♪ And a baked one no less, just like Ena likes!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, and here's a necklace with a plate of curry on it. It even has li'l pickles... I'm gonna drool!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I wonder... Do they have instant noodles...? There you are!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
I wonder how Ena and the others would react to these.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Especially Mafuyu...
What kind of food accessory would get her interested...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not interested.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You really are a wet blanket, you know that? Hey, what about this red bean soup hairpin?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe, how cute. It even has a stretched-out rice cake.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why did you recommend that for me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because your name means “winter”, so you should pick some winter food. Look, they even have New Year's food.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: With all the clothes here, why not make an outfit? This blouse would totally go with red bean soup!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're basing it on the soup...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! Mafuyu's so pretty she could pull off anything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, but if focusing on what she usually wears, this top could work well.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ah, then what about that—

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Just saying it now, but I won't try on either of them.

rows.Speaker: Ena & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Seriously...?
Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If they were here, we could have had fun like that.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If I couldn't decide what color clothes to wear, Ena would give me advice.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Then Kanade would get hungry, and we'd eat cake together.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Mafuyu would probably be her regular self, but we might even find something to get a reaction out of her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We'd have fun, just like our after parties...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This place is full of my favorite things... And there's no one around to annoy me... So...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why do I feel so lonely...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So, that's what the others mean to me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh yeah, Kanade finished looking at my storyboard. I've gotta eat and get back to work.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Footsteps?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: MEIKO?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How did you get here?! I mean, what even is this place?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Calm down.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This is a SEKAI formed from a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A SEKAI? A fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sometimes, a fragment of a feeling that hasn't yet formed a true SEKAI can appear in a SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You touched something glowing before coming here, yes? Touching a fragment can give you a window into the feeling it came from.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So...that's what that ball of light was.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... SEKAI sure is one big mystery, what with stuff like that lying around.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, did you come here the same way? By touching that fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. When I touched it, that door appeared, and this place was on the other side.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Door?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh... There's a door behind her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I walked this way while I was window shopping, but I don't think that was there before...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, anyway. So I can go home through that door, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
But, is that what you want?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're trying to return to a place that makes you unhappy, no?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
...
Well... Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If I don't go back, I can't be with them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Ena said she'd wait for me. So I'd be breaking a promise if I didn't go back.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Not to mention she'd fret and search everywhere for me. And Kanade and Mafuyu would worry too.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I'm going back.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Understood.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, stay close behind me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Got it!
Lead the way, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Thank you...
It was fun.)
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whew, I made it home.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It was such a relief to see our regular SEKAI on the other side of the door.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Guys, are you on?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm here.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Ooh, hi Yuki! I was hoping to talk to you♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Amia, can you turn it down a notch? You hurt my ears just then.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hahaha, sorry!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You seem like you're in a good mood, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, you're especially energetic. What happened? Was your dinner that good?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehehe, maaaybe.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, what's up with you guys? I'm in the mood to chat♪>
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for coming along to buy art supplies with me, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I'm glad she asked me to join her...
All I could think about was what happened when I was by myself.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I did...
But she must've found it while looking around inside my computer when I was out...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I have to think that she also found my lyrics and Nightcord...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Mafuyu's mom contacted me...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<So...
She asked me to stop working on music with Mafuyu.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I said how I'm not in a position to ask her to do that as long as she wishes to keep working with us...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Then, she responded by asking me to meet with her in person...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Easy, Mizuki... You're here to take your mind off things, so no thinking about that right now!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: When I invited you, didn't you say that there were some shops you wanted to check out?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, there are! I was hoping to go around to them after you got everything you needed.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay. So, where did you have in mind?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That apparel shop at the mall we went to a while back! Remember? You bought that really cute blouse there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, that place...
Do they have some new stuff?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, there's that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But some anime-inspired stuff from this show I really like is also supposed to go on sale today♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Anime-inspired stuff?
Like character costumes?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, original outfits based on this one character! You won't believe how cute it is!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Your face is telling me, “You say it's cute, but you only think that because you like this show, right?”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'm not joking when I say it's super cute!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, I get it. Also, what was that just now? Were you trying to impersonate me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Pretty good, right♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? In what way?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Anyway, let's head over!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, here! Found it!
It's this one-piece!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This? It is really cute, and you could wear it on a regular basis too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: See? How many times did I say before that it's super cute?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
However, as a fan of this character...
Check this out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This little bit is what makes it special!
And it's totally obvious if you're her fan.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is that what you meant before?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup.
So, mind if I go try it on?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Be my guest. I'll keep looking through this rack.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, be right back...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Mizuki? Aren't the fitting rooms over that way?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This dress is so nice...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, the little frills on the sleeve are subtle but really cute... At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's pretty casual-looking.
You don't normally wear stuff like this, do you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, but imagine if Kanade wore it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
It'd look perfect on her!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right?! And if you take this with these pants! Ta-daa! It's totally Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is!
But I'm not sure if she'd ever wear something like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. True...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This reminds me of when the four of us went shopping together that one time...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, when we went to see that movie!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We looked for outfits that we thought would look good on Kanade and Mafuyu, and begged them to try them on!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was really fun.
I hope we get another chance to hang out like that again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Same...
They'll probably say no, but wanna try asking them anyway?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Especially since it might help Mafuyu take her mind off things.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, actually... If push comes to shove, I could ask her to model for another painting.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yikes...
Some friend you are.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me? I've been such a good friend to her!

rows.Speaker: Ena & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I really wasn't expecting to run into Mafuyu here like this.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But guess what?! This one shop we went to today had these new outfits that would look so great on you and Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki made a huge fuss about that when we were there too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! Yeah, I did!
So, Mafuyu, wanna invite Kanade and check it out together the next time we can?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Together...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah... We don't know when we'll be able to, but let's set aside some time when we can, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll think about it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's nice that she sort of wants to go out shopping and stuff with us again.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And us chatting like this will hopefully help give her some reprieve from what's been happening!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hmm... What should we talk about next...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, I know...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Speaking of which, we went shoe shopping after looking at clothes. Ena took like twenty minutes to decide whether or not to buy the pair she was looking at...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well all of the little signs for them only had good things written about them which was really shady...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Shady...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They look like an ordinary pair of sneakers, but they apparently help you lose weight just by having them on your feet...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The soles seemed to be designed in a way to make it deliberately hard to maintain your balance, so I guess your legs would sort of get a workout just by walking around in them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They even had these videos playing which seemed to show that they actually work...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All that leaves is for her to actually put them on and exercise...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I doubt she will...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, I...
Might've if I bought them...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, why didn't you buy them?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Even if they don't work as advertised, you'd be motivated to work out and lose weight, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, what she said. You would've felt compelled to exercise and get your legs in shape.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, maybe you should've bought them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? What are you two getting at?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, Mizuki... You don't really exercise since you usually stay in your room while you work, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you have a ton of stamina. Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. That's because I have three healthy meals every day. Unlike a certain someone...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, I have to stand, walk around and carry a bunch of stuff at my job.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This other girl in my class also works in retail and seems much fitter than you, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh? I was under the impression that clothing store employees just stood around all day, but you have to stay pretty active, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, hold up!
Standing around isn't easy! You have no idea how much my legs and back hurt after a shift!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, carrying around stuff takes a lot of out you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What else is there...? Oh, we have sales quotas to meet and have to get in a certain number of customers per day, so you need to be a smooth talker too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You do...?
That seems pretty easy for you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! I chose this job specifically because I thought I'd be great at it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Mizuki, your ribbon...
It's going to get stained...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Whoa, good catch!
It was about to dive right into my parfait!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The ice cream's even starting to melt! You gotta eat it quick!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right!
I got so into our conversation that I totally forgot about it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Mafuyu didn't look so good when I went over to go talk to her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Or am I just overthinking things...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Mafuyu, you drank all your tea. Do you wanna order something else...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, it's okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We've still got some fries, so feel free to have some!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki...
Can you take some of my parfait?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yours? Don't tell me you're already full.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Actually, I am... Kinda...
It was bigger than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'm still working through mine...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Still, I won't be having dinner for a while, so I guess I can lend her a hand.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If you insist...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Shall I have some?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Ena
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That'd be great, but... Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, aren't you having dinner soon...?
Also, the taste...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A little should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I won't know how it tastes, but I don't think I'll hate it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: In that case, Mafuyu, let's help her together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Is it just me or did Mafuyu smile ever so slightly just now...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I hope she's feeling a little better...)
Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now that our new song's been uploaded, it's time we started our usual after-party!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is what I wanna say...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But Mafuyu's running pretty late...
She told us that cram school's taking longer than expected...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, doesn't that mean she wants to come? I'm sure she'll be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I mean, I've gotta think we're all worried about her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We've been chatting through text, but it's been over a week now since we actually worked while talking to each other.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, hey! Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness you could make it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But sorry for being late...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, we get that you're busy. Thanks for making the time to stop by!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, we were just about to start, so your timing couldn't have been better♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Here's your drink.
You'll just have to live with orange juice for now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, where was I?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Everyone, here's to our new song!
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Mafuyu
rows.Line: Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ahh! This juice really hits the spot!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You sound way too excited, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Why wouldn't I be?!
Our new song's been getting a ton of views and comments♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I haven't actually looked yet.
Let's see... Whoa, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We're getting a decent amount of views, but this looks like way more comments than normal. Some of these people have pretty big threads going.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There was a bit of a gap between this one and our last one...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And you may need to wait on me again to complete the lyrics for our next song...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that, Mafuyu.
There's no rush. Just work at your own pace...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll give you as much time as you need.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Did you all see the trailer for the superhero movie from Hollywood that just released?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's the one about how these guys fight against all these different baddies while traveling through space!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Space? Oh, I think I caught a glimpse of it on TV. The CG looked so pretty...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right?! The stars and galaxies looked absolutely gorgeous! Emulating zero gravity is also supposed to be really hard, but they totally nailed it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the music! This one song they used starts out pretty quiet but builds up to this grand climax...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It was even composed by this person who's become really popular producer of healing music!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Healing music...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, the interview on the official site mentioned how they want to immerse the viewer into the movie by shaping what the view feels based on what they're seeing and hearing or whatever.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Interesting...
I'd like to try listening to this song.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu, does their healing music pique your interest at all? It's supposed to be pretty helpful for people who have trouble sleeping.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to give it a listen regardless of whether or not it helps me sleep...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! I'll post it along with the link to the trailer on Nightcord♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The trailer was very well made.
You were right, Mizuki. The music fit the imagery perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I agree... It left a clear impression without interfering with the narration.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
How'd you like the healing music?
Do you think it'll help you sleep better?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, that's too bad.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I thought this composition style sounded familiar. I know this producer. They're pretty famous...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, they've worked with this movie's director on a lot of other stuff.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Also, that's so cool!
You recognized who the producer was just based on their style.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I wish I had the power to say, “Hey, I know who made this!” after hearing or seeing something!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, we get it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I was also really surprised when I found out that this person's new song is a cover of an old one!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, it is?
I couldn't tell. It sounded so modern.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The melody for the original song is also very nice. I actually really like it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What is it called...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, it's called...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki...
Wanna go refill our drinks?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, sure!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is it me or are you trying really hard today, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're doing all this for Mafuyu, right?
You sound way more excited than usual and brought up something that she can directly relate to.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Was it that obvious...?
I guess I went a little overboard.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, you're only being slightly more obnoxious than usual.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! You're so mean!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. In any case, I think your plan's working.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I sure hope so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, I feel that we need to make the most of this sort of time since we're getting less and less time to work together...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, huh? Are you two also getting refills?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I just finished my drink.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay! In that case...!
You gotta try this hyper-fizzy soda♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay, sure...
I'm not against anything carbonated.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
Then, I also recommend mixing it with some orange juice.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I'll try it as is.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They also have some vegetable juice, Kanade. It's actually not bad, so I recommend it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? In that case, I think I'll try some.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It really is nice when we get to just spend time together like this...)
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, the next problem is...
Yikes, reading comprehension... I'm gonna need my Japanese-English dictionary...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They've been making me take so many supplementary classes lately too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Fortunately, neither the teacher nor anyone else from class is here. That means I can take my time and look at my textbook while I try to solve these...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Still, what's with all these worksheets?
Are they really gonna hold me back if I don't finish all of them?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, wait! What if that's just their way of getting me to hit the books...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I should probably just do my best to get through them. Having to repeat a year would be a total drag.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, that's it for English!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That just leaves... Ugh, math...
I hope these problems only need me to plug and chug some formulas.
Huh? Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm? Hey, Ena!
Wait, what are you doing here? Night school doesn't start for a while...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was gonna check out this one store before coming here, but they were closed...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You didn't bother to check beforehand?
Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Laugh all you want. I can always go tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, why are you here? Supplementary classes? Are you sure they're not gonna make you repeat a year?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah, I'm actually pretty good at this stuff. In theory, it shouldn't take me too long.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If anything, my biggest enemy right now is my motivation level. I'm trying to solve these problems, but they're so boring.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Seriously...?
Shouldn't you be trying a little harder since there's a real possibility of you having to repeat?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I am trying...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I know...! You're free until classes start, right? You should stay here and study with me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Oh, actually, we do have math today, and I'm probably gonna get called on...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's all the more reason to stay and study!
Here, sit next to me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Fine, it's not like I have anything else to do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Mizuki, you're working on math too...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. Once I wrap up these problems, I'm free from my supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really...? Oh, this formula looks kinda familiar. What was it for again?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh?
What happened to you being a year ahead of me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't blame me. All this old stuff keeps getting replaced with new information.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to check over what we're covering in class today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Grr. She totally brushed me off.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nothing. It feels like we're at school is all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you mean? We are at school.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know.
Anyway, time to get through these problems!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hm...? That's weird. I thought this formula would give me the answer...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And there's nothing else like it in the textbook...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Ena...?
Is this the right way to solve this problem?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Lemme see.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry, I have no idea...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay.
Hmm... What should I do? This is the only one I can't figure out...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why not just ask the teacher?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No way. Not after saying that it'd be a piece of cake. That'd be like me admitting defeat.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're kidding, right...?
I mean, you can't go home until you solve that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know...
So, I'll just take a picture of this and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Mafuyu, am I solving this problem the right way?>
And send!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You won't ask your teacher, but you're willing to ask Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, 'cause Mafuyu's Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Uh, okay...? Well, we'll see if she responds before the day ends.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, right. Mafuyu's always super busy...
I guess that means I should try a little harder to figure this out on my own.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, hey! Mafuyu replied!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! No way! You literally just sent her that text! She figured it out already?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Looks like it!

Kamiyama High School - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cool. So our class is gonna run an escape room this year...?

rows.Line: Yes. We decided during homeroom last week, and we've already begun preparing for it this week.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess it already is that time of year.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So much stuff happened since I last came to school. But that's also sorta business as usual.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
Because they're festival standards.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Some classes ended up doing the same things during the last festival, so I feel like you guys didn't have to change course.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, we didn't have to.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: More original...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, an escape room would be more of a new experience compared to a maze or haunted house. It could end up being a really big draw!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, have you guys already decided what kinds of riddles you're gonna make?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, we're still in the middle of gathering ideas.
However, we have already begun work on the interior design, posters, flyers, signs and such.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If they've already begun working on it, then that probably means groups have already been decided.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wonder which one I'm in...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I remember my teacher last year saying that anyone who wasn't around was allowed to ask to join whichever group they liked.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, quick question...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What happens to the people who weren't present when you guys decided groups and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, my apologies.
I failed to mention that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're free to join and work with whichever group you like, Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You currently have your choice of interior design, advertising by making and putting up flyers, signs and the like and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Basically the same deal as last year. Which should I join?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (My teacher's been on my case about having to come in at least once every two days because I need to take a bunch of supplementary classes, so I wouldn't really mind working on festival stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But it feels pretty awkward to go ask one of the groups to let me join them.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
What do you think...?
Are there any groups that you'd like to join?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. A couple seemed interesting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Actually, Toya, which group are you in?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I've failed you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I'm actually not in any of the groups.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've been asked to come up with all the riddles, so I'll be focusing on that for the time being.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, you're not in a group...?
You're coming up with the riddles all by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I have asked the rest of the class to give me any suggestions, but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That sounds like a ton of work, though?!
Are you sure you can do this all on your own?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, it may be a lot of work...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I do enjoy puzzles, so I felt I'd be able to handle this job.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, you like puzzles?
I knew that you liked reading mystery novels...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they've been appearing on my social media feed from time to time. I've found that I really enjoy the feeling I get when an answer comes to me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The answers just come to you...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It makes sense. Not only is Toya really studious, he also seems good at thinking outside the box.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hmm... I was hoping to join his group, but based on what he just told me...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Akiyama...
Would you like to help me come up with riddles?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. You don't have to do that for me!
It'll probably go faster if our riddle expert handles everything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I fear that there isn't going to be much variation if I alone come up with them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is precisely why I've been asking the others in class for any suggestions they may have.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, that's what you meant...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't know if it's because they're trying to come up with the best riddles they can, but I'm yet to receive any from them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I'd really appreciate it if I had someone else helping me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, if you're willing to say that, then I'll be happy to hop on board!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I'll be a lot more comfortable helping Toya instead of trying to join a group that already has a ton of people in it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Great, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Since you're here, do you think you could take a look at the riddles I've come up with so far?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! Show me what you got!

rows.Line: Finally...

rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Line:
